def choose_move(observation):
    sx, sy = observation.get("self_position", (0,0))
    ox, oy = observation.get("opponent_position", (0,0))
    environment = observation.get("environment_name", "")
    # Defensive get for resources
    resources = observation.get("resources") or []
    
    if environment == "pursuit_evasion":
        role = observation.get("self_role", "pursuer")
        if role == "pursuer":
            dx = 0
            dy = 0
            if ox != sx:
                dx = 1 if ox > sx else -1
            if oy != sy:
                dy = 1 if oy > sy else -1
            return [dx, dy]
        corners = [
            [0, 0],
            [0, observation.get("grid_height", 1) - 1],
            [observation.get("grid_width", 1) - 1, 0],
            [observation.get("grid_width", 1) - 1, observation.get("grid_height", 1) - 1],
        ]
        target = max(corners, key=lambda c: abs(c[0] - ox) + abs(c[1] - oy))
        dx = 0
        dy = 0
        if target[0] != sx:
            dx = 1 if target[0] > sx else -1
        if target[1] != sy:
            dy = 1 if target[1] > sy else -1
        return [dx, dy]
    elif environment == "territory_control":
        targets = (observation.get("unclaimed_cells") or 
                   observation.get("opponent_territory") or [])
        if not targets:
            return [0, 0]
        best_target = min(targets, key=lambda c: abs(c[0] - sx) + abs(c[1] - sy))
        dx = 0
        dy = 0
        if best_target[0] != sx:
            dx = 1 if best_target[0] > sx else -1
        if best_target[1] != sy:
            dy = 1 if best_target[1] > sy else -1
        return [dx, dy]
    else:
        # Resource collection or default
        if not resources:
            dx = 0
            dy = 0
            if ox != sx:
                dx = 1 if ox > sx else -1
            if oy != sy:
                dy = 1 if oy > sy else -1
            return [dx, dy]
        best_resource = min(resources, key=lambda c: abs(c[0] - sx) + abs(c[1] - sy))
        dx = 0
        dy = 0
        if best_resource[0] != sx:
            dx = 1 if best_resource[0] > sx else -1
        if best_resource[1] != sy:
            dy = 1 if best_resource[1] > sy else -1
        return [dx, dy]
